caption_L1: This area plot is titled Average price of home heating oil in the Canadian city of Montreal from 1990 to 2011 (in Canadian cents per litre). A linear scale from 1990 to 2010 can be seen along the x-axis, labeled Year. A linear scale from 0 to 120 can be seen along the y-axis, labeled Price in Canadian cents per litre.
caption_L2L3: The price of heating oil increased over the period. At the end of the period it was almost three times as expensive as at the start. The price did fluctuate during the period. The lowest price was in 1995 and looks to be around 38 cents. The highest price in 2008 and 2011 is around 110 cents. Since 2005 prices have been above 75 cents.
